001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event;
002
003import lombok.Data;
004import lombok.EqualsAndHashCode;
005
006/**
007 * Trigger while a calendar data was changed by Calendar Watcher. Useful for quickshop simple
008 * scheduler.
009 */
010@EqualsAndHashCode(callSuper = true)
011@Data
012
013public class CalendarEvent extends AbstractQSEvent {
014
015  private CalendarTriggerType calendarTriggerType;
016
017  public CalendarEvent(final CalendarTriggerType calendarTriggerType) {
018
019    this.calendarTriggerType = calendarTriggerType;
020  }
021
022  public enum CalendarTriggerType {
023    NOTHING_CHANGED, SECOND, MINUTE, HOUR, DAY, WEEK, MONTH, YEAR
024  }
025}
